# Hydra Sync 1.4.0

First public release: Hydra Launcher playtime and achievements flowing into Playnite.

## What's new

### Playtime that syncs instead of stacking

Hydra tracks how long you've played each game. Hydra Sync reads those totals and updates
Playnite's playtime to match — but only when Hydra's number is actually **higher**, so a
game that Playnite already tracks well is never inflated by a second counting pass.

- `Game.Playtime` is raised to Hydra's total (in seconds) when Hydra has more time
- `Last activity` moves forward to Hydra's last-played timestamp, never backwards
- Already-in-sync games are left untouched, so repeat syncs are harmless

If a value was replaced that you want back, use **Undo playtime changes…** in the
extension settings — it restores the pre-sync values (exactly for syncs done with this
version or newer).

### Achievements, read from the files already on disk

Achievement unlocks are read from the achievement files your games already write on disk
(same file locations Hydra itself reads), then handed to the Playnite Achievements
extension, where they show up as a normal Steam-sourced achievement list:

- Steam-sourced metadata — names, descriptions and icons — is resolved from local
  `steam_settings` definitions first, then optionally the Steam Web API
  (add your key in the settings), then the public store API
- Progress appears in Playnite Achievements the next time Playnite starts, because that's
  when it imports the data
- A per-game **Diagnose achievement sync…** report shows exactly which files were found,
  which unlocks were parsed, and whether anything is waiting for the import

### Finds Hydra automatically

- Auto-detects the Hydra database under `%APPDATA%\Hydra` and `%APPDATA%\hydralauncher`
  (portable/older installs included), or point it at a custom location
- Matches games by Steam AppID first and by normalized title second
- Syncs games you already have in Playnite — it never adds new titles to your library

### Getting syncs to happen

- **Sync now** in the Playnite main menu under `@Hydra Sync` runs a full pass immediately
- A background timer also ran a pass shortly after Playnite started and then on an
  interval (see the 1.6.0 notes — automatic syncing became opt-in)
- Main menu, settings and per-game diagnostics all live under the `Hydra Sync` section

## Upgrade notes

- First public release — no upgrade path needed.
- Existing installs from earlier builds: nothing to re-sync, the plugin state file is
  reused as-is.
- Automatic syncing is **on by default** in this version. It became opt-in in 1.6.0; if
  you upgrade, enable **Auto-sync** in the settings to keep scheduled passes running.

## Install

1. Download `HydraSync-1.4.0.pext` from the assets below.
2. Double-click it and confirm the install (or extract it into
   `%APPDATA%\Playnite\Extensions\A76358E9-BFA2-4189-B6F3-2307EA4E217B\`).
3. Restart Playnite.

Settings live at **Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra Sync**.
